title: 区分的语言:区分如何生成空间、形式与谱——七条定理、三十六个领域与一次连续极限 / The Language of Distinction: How Distinctions Generate Space, Form and Spectrum — Seven Theorems, Thirty-Six Domains, and One Continuum Limit
description:
中文. 本著作提出“区分的语言”这一语言规范，用以把“统一”从愿望翻译成可检验的操作。

核心主张：把“区分、曲率、演化”三个原语收敛为两个——区分与对称双线性形式；协方差、Hessian、图拉普拉斯、内积与黎曼度量是同一结构在五个领域的实例。它不宣布数学被统一，只交出一种可被使用、压缩与迁移的语言。

结构与证据：25 章、附录 A—P、32 幅图；唯一的完全兑现处是图上两阶段相变（有定理、有临界值、有可复算数值）；局部先行窗口的尺度律 R≈2N^{2/d}/π² 给出可检验的推论。

诚实的纪律：明确区分“定理”“语言规范”与“提案”；19 个开放问题；一次撤回（曲率与谱关系的过度归并）完整记录在正文与附录；并写明本书做的是“用已有工具描述已知结构”，不是“发明新工具发现新现象”。

边界：五个领域中只有一个被严格兑现，其余是结构相似而非同构；“语言规范”指记号系统，不是学科规范。

版本：2026-10-18，226 页，25 章，32 图，附录 A—P，O1—O19；源码与可复算脚本开源，内容 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

本版更新（2026-10-18 地基版）。本版把全书的共同前提写到卷首：现实中不存在无限——无限只作为极限出现在模型里，从不出现在现实系统的实际状态里。有限性本身只说明“有上界”；它要变成“必须让出一样”，还需要三个条件同时成立：需求随规模增长、描述/组合/传递共享同一承载者、同时维持两种活动更贵（交互惩罚 ψ>0）。因此“至多取二”一律是“紧预算（K/D 有界）下至多取二”的简写；若预算增长快于需求，三项可以同时满格。

本版新增内容。第 13 章新增“有限性诊断”：五个领域的二阶结构可读成有限描述的共同压缩方式；1/3 缺口被标为“有限离散描述 + 连续极限”的过路费（可能来源，非证明）。卷首总纲明确：书中的“连续极限/无限细分”是取极限操作，不是现实系统的属性。

系列 / Series. 同一作者的独立研究系列：六本学术专著 + 两本通俗读本。入口与外部登记库：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs；源码与可复算脚本：https://github.com/lyp0746/distinction-evolution。首选预览文件：distinction-evolution-print.pdf（印刷版）。

English. Abstract (English). This work presents “the grammar of distinction,” a language norm that translates the wish for unity into testable operations. Core thesis: three primitives — distinction, curvature, evolution — reduce to two: distinction and the symmetric bilinear form; covariance, Hessian, graph Laplacian, inner product and Riemannian metric are five instances of one structure. It does not claim that mathematics has been unified; it delivers a language that can be used, compressed and transferred. Structure and evidence: 25 chapters, appendices A–P, 32 figures; the one fully cashed-out case is the two-stage transition on graphs (theorem, thresholds, reproducible numbers), with the window law R≈2N^{2/d}/π² as a testable corollary. Discipline: theorems, language norms and proposals are kept apart; 19 open questions; one retraction is documented in full; the book states plainly that it describes known structures with existing tools rather than discovering new phenomena with new ones. Boundaries: only one of five domains is fully cashed out; elsewhere the relation is structural resemblance, and “norm” means notation, not disciplinary rule. Edition: 2026-10-18, 226 pages, 25 chapters, 32 figures, appendices A–P.

What is new in this edition (2026-10-18, Finitude Edition). The common premise is now stated at the front: there is no infinity in reality — infinity appears only as a limit in models, never as a property of a real system. Finitude alone only says that there is a ceiling; to yield a trade-off it also needs three conditions: demand grows with scale, description/composition/transfer share one bearer, and maintaining two activities at once is more expensive (interaction penalty ψ>0). “At most two” is therefore shorthand for “at most two under a tight budget (bounded K/D)”; if the budget grows faster than demand, all three can be full.

New in this edition. Chapter 13 adds a finitude diagnosis: the second-order structure across five domains can be read as a common compression of finite description; the 1/3 gap is framed as the toll of a finite discrete description passing to a continuum limit (a possible source, not a proof). The front matter states that “continuum limit / infinite subdivision” is a limiting operation, not a property of a real system.
